title: CreatorEntity
description: A creator entity represents an individual who has contributed to one or more research works, such as an author or editor.

revision.description: UUID of the current entity revision.

redirect.description: If set, this entity has been merged into the entity with this identifier.

extra.description: Free-form additional metadata about this creator.

display_name.description: Name as should be displayed in web interface or in author lists. Required for valid entities.

given_name.description: In English commonly the first name, but ordering is context and culture specific.

surname.description: In English commonly the last, or family name, but ordering is context and culture specific.
